project.name: E2E Character Animation
project.description: Tests character consistency across scenes and smooth human motion — common failure for video models

source.text: Meet Sarah. She just got the worst news of her morning: the coffee machine is broken.
But then she remembers: there is a cafe right next door.

source.prompt: Sarah slowly lowers her hands from her cheeks and slumps her shoulders. She looks left and right as if hoping someone else has a solution. Subtle body sway.

generate.prompt: A young woman with short brown hair and a yellow cardigan stands in a modern office kitchen, staring at a coffee machine with an 'OUT OF ORDER' sign taped to it. Her expression is one of exaggerated despair, mouth slightly open, hands on cheeks. Warm interior lighting, Pixar-style 3D render, soft shadows.

source.prompt: Her face lights up. She spins on her heel and walks confidently toward the glass door. The camera follows her slightly.

generate.prompt: The same young woman with short brown hair and a yellow cardigan, now smiling brightly with a lightbulb moment expression. She points toward a glass door that shows a sunny street outside with a small cafe visible across the road. Same modern office kitchen background. Pixar-style 3D render, warm lighting.
